evidence: Each job card on homepage (e.g. job-1) shows title, company, industry badge, employment type badge, location, salary range, posting date, and skill tags.
job-1 details page shows title, company, industry, employment type, location, salary, posting date, full description (responsibilities/requirements), and required skills.
Homepage listed 8 jobs matching 'Showing 8 jobs' count; clicking a job card opened /jobs/job-1 with full detail view.

Submitting empty form leaves required fields (name, email, message) marked invalid via native 'Please fill out this field' validation and focuses first invalid field; entering 'not-an-email' triggers 'Please include an @ in the email address' validation message and blocks submission.
Submitting valid name/email/phone/message on job-1 triggered a toast: 'Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent.'

issue: Duplicate application with same email not blocked
actual: Submitted a second application for job-1 using the same email (test.user@example.com) already used for that job. The app accepted it, showed 'Application submitted!' success toast, and both 'Test User' and 'Test User Duplicate' now appear as two separate application records under job-1 in the employer dashboard (application count went from 3 to 4, not blocked or deduplicated).

evidence: Clicking the application-count button (4) on Senior Frontend Developer job expanded an 'Applications (4)' list showing each applicant's details.

Each application record in the employer dashboard list shows applicant name, email, optional phone (present for some, absent for others), message, and a relative/date submission timestamp (e.g. 'Yesterday', 'Jan 20').

First valid application (Test User) produced a visible success toast and appeared exactly once under Senior Frontend Developer in the employer dashboard with the exact name, email, phone, and message submitted.
Employer dashboard shows 'Active Jobs: 5' matching the 5 listed jobs for this employer, and 'Total Applications: 5' matching the sum of per-job application counts (4+1+0+0+0).

issue: Job posted despite invalid salary range and missing required skill
actual: Submitted the Post a Job form with Minimum Salary=150000 > Maximum Salary=90000 and with zero required skills added (title, industry, type, location, description were filled). The app accepted it, showed 'Job posted successfully!' and created a listing 'QA Test Engineer' displaying '$150k - $90k' with no skills tags, instead of rejecting the invalid min>max salary and missing-skill submission with clear feedback.

evidence: Deleting 'QA Test Engineer' job showed a confirmation dialog ('Delete this job? ... cannot be undone') with Cancel/Delete. Confirming removed it from employer dashboard (Active Jobs 6→5) and from the job-seeker listing (back to original 8 jobs, job no longer present).

Published 'Backend Engineer' job with title/industry(Engineering)/type(Full-time)/location(Chicago, IL)/salary($100k-$150k)/description/skills(Java, SQL). Toast confirmed 'Job posted successfully!'. Job appeared in employer dashboard (Active Jobs 5→6) and in job-seeker listing (Showing 8→9 jobs, new card visible with all details).

issue: Newly created job/application dates show incorrect relative date
actual: Browser system clock confirmed as Aug 25 2026 (current date). A job posted at that moment shows 'Posted Yesterday' instead of 'Posted Today', and applications submitted moments earlier show 'Yesterday' instead of 'Today', indicating the relative-date computation is off by one day relative to the true current date.

evidence: Industry=Technology filtered to 2 jobs; adding Location=Seattle,WA narrowed to 1 job (DevOps Engineer); adding Job Type=Full-time (incompatible combo) correctly yielded 0 results; Clear filters restored all 9 jobs.

Each filter change immediately updated the result count and list ('Showing 9 jobs'→'Showing 2 jobs'→'Showing 1 jobs'→'Showing 0 jobs' with 'No jobs found' message); Clear filters immediately restored 'Showing 9 jobs'.

Search 'techcorp' (lowercase) matched 3 jobs by company name 'TechCorp Solutions'; 'kubernetes' (lowercase) matched 1 job by skill tag 'Kubernetes'; 'NURSE' (uppercase) matched 1 job by title 'Registered Nurse'. Count and list updated immediately for each keystroke change.

issue: No edit functionality exists for published jobs
actual: Inspected the employer dashboard job listing controls: each job row only exposes a 'View applications' (users icon) button and a 'Delete' (trash icon) button — confirmed via DOM inspection (button classes/icons: lucide-users and lucide-trash2 only). Clicking the job title/card does not open an edit form. No edit/pencil control or edit route is exposed anywhere in the employer dashboard or job details page, so employers cannot modify a published job's details.

issue: Data does not persist across page reload
actual: Before reload: 9 jobs existed (8 seed + 'Backend Engineer'), job-1 had 4 applications (2 seed + 2 test submissions), and 'QA Test Engineer' had been deleted. After navigating to http://localhost:6003/ again (reload), the listing reverted to exactly the original 8 seed jobs — 'Backend Engineer' job is gone, meaning published jobs, submitted applications, and deletions are not retained; state is held only in-memory/client-side and resets on reload.
